note: Pulaski County KY parcels are published only through the Schneider Beacon/qPublic PVA viewer, a non-ArcGIS web app that returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) to automated access. The county assessor's raw export is a CAMA real-property zip (no polygons) on Dropbox. The Kentucky state server hosts only Webster County's PVA parcel service; no Pulaski layer. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no public Pulaski KY parcel feature service. Commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo, Rockford, Acres) are paid.
